en.name: China–LATAM Consumer Goods Sourcing Fair
en.description: Guangzhou manufacturers meet LATAM retail buyers. Home goods, electronics accessories, packaging, and food ingredients.
en.metaTitle: China–LATAM Consumer Goods Sourcing Fair | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Guangzhou manufacturers meet LATAM retail buyers. Home goods, electronics accessories, packaging, and food ingredients. Guangzhou, 25–27 February 2026.
en.overviewHtml: A sourcing fair connecting Guangzhou manufacturers with LATAM retail buyers across home goods, electronics accessories, packaging, and food ingredients.

cn.name: 中国–拉丁美洲消费品采购展
cn.description: 广州制造商与拉丁美洲零售采购商对接，涵盖家居用品、电子配件、包装及食品原料。
cn.metaTitle: 中国–拉丁美洲消费品采购展 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 2026年2月25–27日，广州，广州制造商与拉丁美洲零售采购商对接，涵盖家居用品、电子配件、包装及食品原料。
cn.overviewHtml: 一场采购展览会，将广州制造商与拉丁美洲零售采购商在家居用品、电子配件、包装及食品原料领域相连。
cn.whoShouldAttendHtml: 为拉丁美洲市场采购消费品的零售采购商与品类经理。
cn.formatHtml: 按品类划分的展厅式摊位，并提供预先安排的买家会面。
